intro.heading: We Build the Web. Done Right.
paragraphs: APalevich.Pro is a lean, experienced web development team focused on one thing: delivering fast, beautiful applications that drive real business results.
We're not a massive agency with dozens of teams. We're a small, specialized group that takes on meaningful projects and cares deeply about execution quality.

Since 2019, we've helped startups, Fortune 500 companies, and everyone in between achieve their digital ambitions. Our philosophy: understand the problem, solve it elegantly, and move on to the next challenge.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

questions.question: What's your typical project timeline?
questions.answer: It depends on scope. Small projects (landing pages, simple features) take 2–4 weeks. Larger applications or significant optimizations typically take 6–12 weeks. We'll give you a realistic estimate after our discovery call.

questions.question: Do you work with startups?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We love working with early-stage companies and help them make smart technical decisions that support their growth. We offer flexible engagement models and can scale with you.

questions.question: What technologies do you use?
questions.answer: We specialize in modern web tech: React, Next.js, Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare). We'll always choose the right tool for your project, not force a particular stack.

questions.question: Do you offer post-launch support?
questions.answer: Yes. We offer support packages for everything from bug fixes and feature development to performance optimization and ongoing maintenance. We'll discuss options that fit your needs.

questions.question: How much does a project cost?
questions.answer: It varies widely based on scope, complexity, and timeline. We typically charge between $10K–$100K+ for full projects. Let's talk about your specific needs and budget to find the right fit.

questions.question: Can you work with our existing team?
questions.answer: Definitely. Many clients already have internal teams, and we're happy to collaborate, mentor, or augment their capabilities. We'll integrate smoothly with your workflow.

faq.footer: Didn't find your answer? Send us a message in the form above or email directly, and we'll get back to you promptly.
